definitions.full: H1250. bar III. בַּר noun masculine grain, corn (compare Arabic wheat, grain of wheat ), Psa 72:16 ; Amos 5:11 ; 8:5-6 , בָּר Gen 41:35 , 49 ; 42:3 , 25 ; 45:23 (E) Psalm 65:14; Prov 11:26 ; Jer 23:28 ; Joel 2:24 . בָּר noun masculine field (Biblical Aramaic בָּרָא , Syriac , Arabic open country, land ) — בַבָּר יִרְבּוּ they grow up in the open field Job 39:4 (Aramaic usage). ברר (√ of following; Biblical Hebrew בָּר ברר, Job 39:4 ).
definitions.rootNote: or בַּר ; from 1305 (in the sense of winnowing);
